result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser or run `check:ui`, so the layout and contrast are unchecked.

- **Layout:** it follows DESIGN.md's Screens rules. The page is white, one column up to 1120px, with 48px above and 32px at the sides. The heading "Notifications" is on the left in Unbounded Light caps. "Mark All as Read" is on the right as the screen's one primary button: ink pill, 44px tall.
- **List:** the six notifications sit in one card, in rows 52px tall with 1px dividers. The first three are unread, shown with an accent dot and semibold ink text. The other three are muted. The time is on the right of each row.
- **Icons:** I added a decorative icon tile to each row, drawn in `currentColor`. Each unread dot has `aria-label="Unread"`.
- **Content:** the text is exactly what you listed, with nothing added.
- **Tokens:** the day-theme tokens are inlined, so the file is self-contained. Colours, spacing, radii and tracking come from them, with no raw hex outside the token block.
- **Fonts:** Unbounded and Archivo aren't available as assets here, so the file uses the token font stacks. It will render in the `system-ui` fallback unless those fonts are installed.
- **Nav:** I left out the top navigation bar, since it isn't in the acceptance criteria.
